info.name: DIGIT v2.12 — upgrade seed load
info.description:
Loads the seed data a v2.12-beta -> v2.12 UPGRADE does not migrate: 742 records, taken row-by-row from the difference between full-dump.sql at v2.12-beta and at v2.12.

WHY: full-dump.sql only loads at Postgres initdb, i.e. on a FRESH install. An upgrade never replays it, so the tenant keeps beta's data. Verified on an upgraded box: 0 of the 729 new access-control rows were present.

WHY DIRECT mdms-v2, NOT KONG: mdms-v2 authorises per schema (an action per /mdms-v2/v2/_create/<schema>). Through Kong, writes to schemas with no such action return 403 AccessDeniedException. {{mdmsUrl}} bypasses accesscontrol, the same approach enable-dashboard.sh takes.

ORDER: run folder 05 (schema definitions) BEFORE folder 10, or the five RejectionReasons
records fail with SCHEMA_DEFINITION_NOT_FOUND_ERR.

RUN (regenerate the data file per tenant first):
  python3 generate-seed-data.py --tenant <tenant_id>
  newman run ga-upgrade-seed-load.postman_collection.json \
    -d ga-upgrade-seed-load.data.<tenant_id>.json \
    --env-var mdmsUrl=http://localhost:18094 --env-var url=http://localhost:18000 \
    --env-var stateTenant=<tenant_id>

Folder 30 is EXPECTED to fail with UNIQUE_KEY_UPDATE_ERR; see its description.

TENANT VARIABLES ARE BLANK BY DESIGN. stateTenant/cityTenant must be supplied per run; a collection-level pre-request guard aborts each request and prints why if stateTenant is missing, or if the -d data file was generated for a different tenant. Add --bail so the run stops on the first such error instead of continuing.

Re-running is safe: an existing schema returns a duplicate error, which the test below accepts.
